endorsements.name: Mohin Paramasivam
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-47935
endorsements.description: Sentry 8.2.0 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated superusers to execute arbitrary commands by injecting malicious pickle-serialized objects through the audit log entry data parameter. Attackers can submit crafted POST requests to the admin audit log endpoint with base64-encoded compressed pickle payloads in the data field to achieve code execution with application privileges.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.8)

endorsements.name: Mohin Paramasivam
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-47941
endorsements.description: WordPress Plugin Survey & Poll 1.5.7.3 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary SQL queries by injecting malicious code through the wp_sap cookie parameter. Attackers can craft SQL payloads in the cookie to extract sensitive database information including usernames, passwords, and other confidential data from the WordPress database.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.8)
